headline: Review of Round 14 Community Preservation Act pre-applications and out-of-cycle projects for Lynch Park and Central Cemetery.
summary: The committee will review Round 14 pre-applications for projects including Cooney Field Playground Renovation, McPherson Youth Center Lighting, Obear Park Renovation, Community Center Renovation, Beverly Golf and Tennis Club Renovation, First Parish Church Renovation, and Greater Beverly YMCA Fitness Trails. It will also discuss out-of-cycle projects, project updates, and a project closeout.
